exhibit_title: AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO THE FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT
note: avenant n° 3 à l'accord-cadre du 16 septembre 2019 (bon de travail n° 1) et à la lettre commerciale du 15 février 2019 entre Amazon.com, Inc. et Rivian Automotive, Inc. : la section 2.2 de la lettre commerciale est supprimée ; avenant autonome, corps à lire en passe C (D-0036)
quote: This Amendment No. 3 to the Framework Agreement (this "Amendment"), between Amazon Logistics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Amazon") and Rivian Automotive, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Rivian"), is dated as of November 7, 2023 (the "Amendment Effective Date").
